title: Search a 2D Matrix
summary: Find a value in a grid whose rows are sorted and where each row starts above the end of the previous row.

tests.explain: 13 would fall between 11 and 16 in the second row, but it is not there.
The last cell is a valid target; treating the grid as one sorted list of 12 values makes this a normal binary search.

hints: Read the grid row by row in your head. Because each row starts above the last value of the row before, the whole thing is one long sorted list.
Binary search over the positions 0 to rows * columns - 1 without building that list.
Convert a position mid into a cell with row = Math.floor(mid / cols) and col = mid % cols, then compare matrix[row][col] to the target as in a normal binary search.
